title: Talk-back, Hausa
note: A representative replay of a real exchange. Timings are illustrative, not measured on this page.

turns.text: Lafiya lau, na gode. Aiki yana tafiya da kyau. Kai fa, yaya gida?
turns.gloss: Fine, thank you. Work is going well. And you, how is home?
Home is fine. I am learning Hausa.

turns.text: Madalla! Ka yi kyau sosai. Mu ci gaba.
turns.gloss: Excellent! You are doing very well. Let us continue.
